facts.fact: 装满泡泡糖的火车叫 chew-chew train：choo-choo（火车汽笛）被换成嚼东西的声音
facts.anchor: What do you call a train filled with bubblegum? A chew-chew train.

facts.fact: 被亨氏工厂开除的原因不能说，对方却说“把豆子倒出来吧”：spill the beans（说出秘密）在豆子工厂变成字面动作
facts.anchor: ‘I’m not going to tell you what I did to get sacked from the Heinz factory.’ ‘Spill the beans?’

facts.fact: 佛教徒买热狗说“给我一个与万物合一的”：make me one with everything 兼指“什么配料都要”
facts.anchor: What did the Buddhist say to the hot dog seller? ‘Make me one with everything.’

facts.fact: 牡蛎不肯借钱，因为它们 shellfish：shellfish（贝类）与 selfish（自私）同音
facts.anchor: Why won’t oysters ever lend you money? They’re shellfish.

facts.fact: 假面条叫 impasta：impostor（冒牌货）与 pasta 拼合
facts.anchor: What do you call a fake noodle? An impasta.

facts.fact: 两只手都能拿糖：ambidextrous（双手灵巧）被换成 ambidextrose（dextrose 葡萄糖）
facts.anchor: I can hold sugar in either hand. I’m ambidextrose.

facts.fact: 甜瓜坚持在教堂结婚，因为它们 cantaloupe：can’t elope（不能私奔）同音
facts.anchor: Why do melons insist on traditional church weddings? Because they cantaloupe.

facts.fact: 玉米饼电影拍完了，说 That’s a wrap：wrap 兼指“收工”与“卷饼”
facts.anchor: They’ve just finished shooting Tortilla: The Movie. That’s a wrap!

facts.fact: 两根香肠在锅里聊天，第二根惊讶的不是热而是“香肠会说话”：元笑话，把荒诞点放在错的地方
facts.anchor: Two sausages are sizzling in a pan. One says, ‘Wow, it’s hot in here!’ The other says, ‘WHOA! A TALKING SAUSAGE!’

facts.fact: 谁的奶酪？nacho cheese 听起来像 not your cheese（不是你的）
facts.anchor: What cheese is someone else’s? Nacho cheese!

facts.fact: 哪种奶酪是倒着做的？Edam 倒过来拼就是 made
facts.anchor: What cheese is made backwards? Edam.
